description: The errors a read-only checkpoint store reports (design/51-Read-Only-Store-Open.md, "Errors"), the same in both engines and the strata CLI. Each message is a template: a {name} is replaced by the value named, and the rest is matched exactly. Opening a store read-only creates nothing, never migrates, and refuses what it can't read; every write on it is refused. Connection failures keep the driver's own error. Read by both runtimes' read-only store tests and the CLI's.

open.missing_sqlite_file: no SQLite store at '{path}': the file doesn't exist
open.newer_version: database is at checkpoints schema version {found}, and this build knows {known}: upgrade the runtime
open.version_zero: database is at checkpoints schema version 0, and a read-only store reads 1 to {known}: open it once with a runtime to migrate it
open.hot_journal: '{path}' has an unfinished write: open it once with the application that writes it
open.redis_prefix_not_indexed: no Strata thread index under prefix '{prefix}': nothing was written there, or no current runtime has connected to it

write.template: the store was opened read-only: {operation} is refused

store_names.sqlite: the path the store was opened with
